description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 06.06.2016 to 12.06.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining currency conversion rates for import/export transactions. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
